records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Vantage Logistics!
records.body:
Hi Kai,

Your Wrenfield account is live. A simple way to start: one project, a handful of real tasks, then an invite to a teammate. No need to overthink the setup.

Here if you need anything.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: 6 days post-signup with zero product activity (no first project, no invite, no key milestone), no tickets, and no reply to the welcome email [email:05c477f6]. Silent Starter accounts that haven't started by day 6 rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: A simple first step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Kai,

Checking in now that your Wrenfield account has been live a few days. The easiest starting point is still one project with a few real tasks: projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Chidi
